messages.author: 1eac52b242972b60
messages.subject: featureCounts numOfBuckets error
parts:
Hi All,

I was hoping you could help me. I am running featureCounts on some metagenomics data using a custom GTF file (~4Gb in size) and large BAM mappings to contigs (each BAM is around 12Gb and there are 16 BAMs).
This has run before no problem on a slightly smaller run, so I assumed it might be size related. But the error I am getting suggests otherwise.

featureCounts throws the following error when loading the :

"||    Paired-end reads are included.                                          ||
    ||    Assign alignments to features...                                        ||
    featureCounts: hashtable.c:172: HashTableCreate: Assertion `numOfBuckets > 0' failed."

Any ideas what is going wrong?

Thanks,
Matt

messages.author: bce99ba71cd48eea
messages.subject: Re: featureCounts numOfBuckets error
parts:
Hi Matt,

Although your GTF file is indeed huge, its size shouldn't be a problem for featureCounts. I've just generated a GTF file having 50 million lines and 4GB large, but featureCounts did read assignment with no errors on it. The peak memory use was 5.2GB.

Can you provide more details on:

1) the full command line for running featureCounts.
2) the lines in your GTF file.
3) the amount of meta-features (eg different gene_ids) in your GTF file.
4) the version of featureCounts you are using.
5) the size of your BAM file
6) the Operating System where you run the program. 

Also, it is best if you can provide us your GTF file and BAM files, so we can reproduce the error.

Cheers,
Yang

1) featureCounts -a annotation.gtf -o counts.tsv -g gene_id -t ORF -F GTF -O --minOverlap 1 --fracOverlap 0 --fracOverlapFeature 0 -M -s 0 -P -T 20 --tmpDir /gfs/scratch/ mappings.bam
2) head of gtf attached
3) 27118625
4) 1.6.3 but I just tried running it with 1.6.0 and got this error instead ' featureCounts: input-files.c:2786: SAM_pairer_get_next_read_BIN: Assertion `l_name < 256' failed.'
5) 16 Bam files, all ranging from 11-15GB
6) Running on a linux compute cluster with plenty of ram

I have attached heads from the bam and gtf, and the error given by subreads

Thanks again,
Matt

messages.author: bce99ba71cd48eea
messages.subject: Re: featureCounts numOfBuckets error
parts:
Hi Matt,

Thank you for the details! However, I still have no clue on the cause of the problem. I used the small GTF file you provided with the same command line to run featureCounts, but it worked correctly on my Linux server.

Can you please try the featureCounts program in the latest Subread package (v1.6.3)? You can download it from  https://sourceforge.net/projects/subread/files/subread-1.6.3/ . There were some bugs in the old version of featureCounts related to the BAM format, so maybe the latest version can solve the problem.

Also, is the error specific to the first BAM file in your list? Can you change the order of the input BAM files to see if the other BAM files can also trigger the error?

Cheers,
Yang
